mapper.update: UPDATE ai_message SET content = #{content}, status = 'FAILED', agentErrorKey = #{agentErrorKey}, retryable = 1, updateTime = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{messageId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' AND status = 'PENDING' AND isDelete = 0 AND createTime < #{expireBefore}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.conversationId FROM ai_message m INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversationId AND c.isDelete = 0 WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND m.status = 'PENDING' AND m.isDelete = 0 AND m.createTime < #{expireBefore} ORDER BY m.createTime ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
